words.enDefinition: a notice stating that a requested appointment is booked

examples.en: The clinic sent an appointment confirmation as soon as I selected a time on the website.
examples.zh: 我在网站上选好时间，诊所随即发来了「预约确认」。

examples.en: I checked the appointment confirmation because the clinic has two offices on the same street.
examples.zh: 诊所在同一条街上有两个地点，我就核对了「预约确认」。

words.enDefinition: whether and when appointments are open for booking

examples.en: The receptionist checked appointment availability while I looked up the dates of my exams.
examples.zh: 前台查「可预约情况」时，我查了一下自己的考试日期。

examples.en: The website shows appointment availability for both branches after you choose a clinician.
examples.zh: 选择医务人员后，网站会显示两个分诊点的「可预约情况」。

words.enDefinition: the earliest open time for someone to be seen

examples.en: I asked for the next available appointment because my timetable was flexible that week.
examples.zh: 那周我的课表比较灵活，就问了「最早可约的时间」。

examples.en: The next available appointment was on Friday, so I wrote it down before ending the call.
examples.zh: 「最早可约的时间」是星期五，我在挂电话前记了下来。

collocations: ask for the next available appointment

words.enDefinition: a standard consultation for something that can wait

examples.en: The receptionist asked whether I wanted a routine appointment with my regular doctor next week.
examples.zh: 前台问我是否想约下周和常看的医生做一次「常规就诊」。

examples.en: The practice texted me a reminder about my routine appointment while I was in class.
examples.zh: 我上课时，诊所发短信提醒我有一次「常规预约」。

words.enDefinition: a consultation arranged to assess a concern promptly

examples.en: The receptionist passed my request for an urgent appointment to the nurse for review.
examples.zh: 前台把我的「加急就诊预约」申请交给护士审核。

examples.en: The clinic recorded the time of my call when I asked about an urgent appointment.
examples.zh: 我询问「加急就诊预约」时，诊所记下了我打电话的时间。

words.enDefinition: a consultation attended physically at the clinic

examples.en: I chose an in-person appointment because I was already on campus near the clinic.
examples.zh: 我当时就在诊所附近的校园里，就选了「现场就诊预约」。

examples.en: The confirmation listed the building entrance to use for my in-person appointment next Wednesday.
examples.zh: 确认消息注明，下星期三「现场就诊」应走哪个楼门。

words.enDefinition: an appointment conducted over a telephone call

examples.en: I gave reception my mobile number for the telephone appointment booked for next Monday.
examples.zh: 我把手机号留给前台，用于下星期一的「电话问诊预约」。

examples.en: The clinic sent a time window for the telephone appointment instead of a room number.
examples.zh: 诊所发来的是「电话问诊」的时间段，没有给房间号。

words.enDefinition: a healthcare consultation conducted through a video call

examples.en: The receptionist sent a link for the video consultation along with the scheduled start time.
examples.zh: 前台发来了「视频问诊」的链接和计划开始时间。

examples.en: I put on headphones before joining the video consultation so my flatmates could study in peace.
examples.zh: 为了不打扰室友学习，我戴上了耳机才参加「视频问诊」。

collocations: a link for a video consultation

words.enDefinition: the first appointment to discuss a particular concern

examples.en: The doctor reviewed my main concern during the initial consultation and explained what would happen next.
examples.zh: 医生在「首次问诊」中了解了我最想咨询的问题，并说明下一步安排。

examples.en: I brought the previous clinic's summary to my initial consultation with the new specialist.
examples.zh: 我带着上一家诊所的摘要去见新专科医生，参加了「首次问诊」。

words.enDefinition: a later consultation to review earlier care or findings

examples.en: The clinic offered me a follow-up appointment after the doctor had finished reviewing my notes.
examples.zh: 医生看完我的记录后，诊所问我是否想约一次「复诊」。

examples.en: I moved my follow-up appointment to Thursday because I had a presentation on Tuesday.
examples.zh: 我星期二有展示，就把「复诊预约」改到了星期四。

words.enDefinition: a general health examination scheduled about once a year

examples.en: The clinic's website shows which forms to fill out before an annual checkup.
examples.zh: 诊所网站说明了「年度体检」前要填写哪些表格。

examples.en: My annual checkup was on a Friday, so I changed my afternoon study group.
examples.zh: 「年度体检」在星期五，我就调整了下午的小组学习安排。

words.enDefinition: a visit focused on preventing problems rather than treating symptoms

examples.en: The receptionist asked whether my booking was for a preventive visit or a specific concern.
examples.zh: 前台问我约的是「预防保健就诊」，还是有具体问题要咨询。

examples.en: The clinic described a preventive visit in the information it sent to new students.
examples.zh: 诊所在发给新生的资料里介绍了「预防保健就诊」。

collocations: discuss options during a preventive visit

words.enDefinition: an appointment for someone attending the practice for the first time

examples.en: The receptionist emailed me two forms to complete before my new patient appointment.
examples.zh: 前台发了两份表格，让我在「新患者预约」就诊前填好。

examples.en: I chose a new patient appointment because I had never visited that practice before.
examples.zh: 我之前没去过那家诊所，就选了「新患者预约」。

collocations: prepare for a new patient appointment

words.enDefinition: a person who has already received care from a practice

examples.en: The receptionist asked whether I was an established patient before checking the clinic's schedule.
examples.zh: 前台在查医生排班前，先问我是不是「在本诊所就诊过的患者」。

examples.en: I selected established patient on the website because the same practice had seen me last year.
examples.zh: 因为去年在同一家诊所看过病，我在网站上选了「本诊所就诊过的患者」。

collocations: an established patient at the practice

words.enDefinition: a doctor providing general rather than specialized medical care

examples.en: I asked the general practitioner who I should contact about the booking after our call.
examples.zh: 通话结束前，我问「全科医生」之后该联系谁确认预约。

examples.en: The student adviser explained how to find a general practitioner near my new accommodation.
examples.zh: 学生顾问给我讲了怎么在新住处附近找「全科医生」。

words.enDefinition: a clinician who provides general first-contact care

examples.en: The form asked me to name my primary care provider before submitting the referral request.
examples.zh: 表格让我填上自己的「初级保健人员」，再提交转诊申请。

examples.en: I called my primary care provider to find out whether the clinic had received my records.
examples.zh: 我打电话给我的「初级保健人员」，想确认诊所是否收到了我的记录。

words.enDefinition: a British term for a clinic providing general medical care

examples.en: I walked past the GP surgery twice because its entrance was behind the pharmacy.
examples.zh: 「全科诊所」的入口在药房后面，我走过两次都没看到。

examples.en: The GP surgery emailed me directions to its second branch before my first visit.
examples.zh: 我第一次去之前，「全科诊所」发邮件告诉我第二个分诊点怎么走。

words.enDefinition: a staff member handling visitors and bookings at a clinic

examples.en: The clinic receptionist asked me to confirm which day I could come in person.
examples.zh: 「诊所前台接待员」让我确认哪一天能到现场就诊。

examples.en: I told the clinic receptionist that the appointment message displayed the wrong campus building.
examples.zh: 我告诉「诊所前台接待员」，预约消息里显示的校园楼号不对。

words.enDefinition: an outpatient facility providing healthcare to a local population

examples.en: I found a community health center within walking distance of the library near my flat.
examples.zh: 我家附近的图书馆旁有一个步行可达的「社区卫生中心」。

examples.en: The community health center told me which desk would handle my first visit there.
examples.zh: 「社区卫生中心」告诉我第一次来该到哪个窗口办理。

words.enDefinition: someone who comes to a clinic without a booking

examples.en: The receptionist explained what information I needed to provide as a walk-in patient that morning.
examples.zh: 前台告诉我，作为当天上午「未预约就诊的患者」，需要提供哪些信息。

examples.en: As a walk-in patient, I was asked to confirm my contact number at the desk.
examples.zh: 我是「未预约就诊的患者」，前台请我确认联系电话。

words.enDefinition: to see people who arrive without an advance booking

examples.en: I called before leaving campus to ask if the clinic would accept walk-ins that afternoon.
examples.zh: 离开校园前，我打电话问诊所当天下午会不会「接待未预约患者」。

examples.en: The notice explains when staff can accept walk-ins and when patients need to book ahead.
examples.zh: 告示说明了什么时候可以「接待未预约患者」，什么时候需要提前约。

words.enDefinition: a healthcare clinic where patients do not stay overnight

examples.en: The signs for the outpatient clinic were beside the main hospital entrance near the lifts.
examples.zh: 「门诊诊所」的指示牌就在医院主入口旁边，靠近电梯。

examples.en: I rang the outpatient clinic to confirm the appointment after receiving the letter yesterday.
examples.zh: 昨天收到信后，我给「门诊诊所」打电话确认了预约。

collocations: check in at the outpatient clinic

words.enDefinition: a scheduled healthcare visit without an overnight admission

examples.en: My outpatient appointment was in a different building from the one shown on the campus map.
examples.zh: 我的「门诊预约」所在的楼和校园地图上标的不一样。

examples.en: I emailed my tutor because the outpatient appointment clashed with a seminar in the afternoon.
examples.zh: 「门诊预约」和下午的研讨课冲突了，我就给导师发了邮件。

collocations: the date of an outpatient appointment

words.enDefinition: the times a clinic is open to see patients

examples.en: The clinic hours changed during the university holidays, so I checked the notice board.
examples.zh: 学校放假期间「诊所开放时间」有变化，我就查看了公告栏。

examples.en: I checked the clinic hours before walking across town to drop off the form.
examples.zh: 我在步行穿过市区交表之前，先查了「诊所开放时间」。

words.enDefinition: a clinic that sees patients outside normal office hours

examples.en: Reception gave me the address of an after-hours clinic when I asked about evening appointments.
examples.zh: 我问有没有晚间预约时，前台给了我一家「非工作时间门诊」的地址。

examples.en: I looked up how to reach the after-hours clinic by bus from my university.
examples.zh: 我查了从学校坐公交怎么去「非工作时间门诊」。

words.enDefinition: a telephone line used for making appointments

examples.en: The hospital letter gave me a separate booking line for changing the date of my visit.
examples.zh: 医院来信提供了一条单独的「预约专线」，用来更改就诊日期。

examples.en: I reached the booking line just after the office opened on Monday morning.
examples.zh: 星期一早上办公室刚开门，我就打通了「预约专线」。

words.enDefinition: the process of reserving an appointment through a website

examples.en: The practice offers online booking for a small number of appointments each morning.
examples.zh: 诊所每天上午会放少量号供「网上预约」。

examples.en: I tried online booking first because the phone line was busy during my lunch break.
examples.zh: 午休时电话占线，我就先试了「网上预约」。

words.enDefinition: a secure online service for accessing clinic information

examples.en: The patient portal displayed the new address after I submitted the change last week.
examples.zh: 我上周提交地址变更后，「患者服务平台」上显示了新地址。

examples.en: I found the clinic's message about my appointment by signing into the patient portal.
examples.zh: 我登录「患者服务平台」，找到了诊所发来的预约消息。

collocations: upload a document to the patient portal

words.enDefinition: the process of recording someone as a practice patient

examples.en: The clinic's patient registration process took less time than I had expected that morning.
examples.zh: 那天上午，诊所的「患者登记」流程比我预计的快。

examples.en: I checked whether patient registration had gone through before asking about appointment times.
examples.zh: 我先确认「患者登记」有没有办妥，再问可以约什么时间。

words.enDefinition: a form collecting basic information before an appointment

examples.en: The clinic emailed an intake form asking about previous care and how to contact me.
examples.zh: 诊所发来一份「接诊信息表」，询问之前的就诊情况和联系方式。

examples.en: I took my intake form to the receptionist after filling it out at home.
examples.zh: 我在家填好「接诊信息表」，拿给了前台。

words.enDefinition: the process of gathering information before clinical care

examples.en: The first part of patient intake involved checking my address and completing a short form.
examples.zh: 「接诊信息采集」的第一部分是确认地址，并填一份简短的表。

examples.en: The clinic usually completes patient intake before the clinician calls someone into the exam room.
examples.zh: 诊所通常会在医务人员叫人进诊室前完成「接诊信息采集」。

words.enDefinition: the counter where clinic visitors register or report arrival

examples.en: The sign at the hospital entrance showed which floor had the outpatient registration desk.
examples.zh: 医院入口的指示牌标出了门诊「挂号窗口」在几楼。

examples.en: I showed the appointment message at the registration desk and waited for further instructions.
examples.zh: 我在「挂号窗口」出示预约消息，然后等工作人员下一步指示。

words.enDefinition: to tell front desk staff that you have arrived

examples.en: The email asked me to check in at reception fifteen minutes before the scheduled time.
examples.zh: 邮件让我在预约时间前十五分钟「到前台报到」。

examples.en: I went to check in at reception before taking a seat near the window.
examples.zh: 我先去「前台报到」，然后在窗边找了个座位。

collocations: arrive early to check in at reception
check in at reception upon arrival
remember to check in at reception

words.enDefinition: reaching an appointment after the scheduled time

examples.en: I phoned the clinic about my late arrival after the bus stopped running that morning.
examples.zh: 当天早上公交停运了，我打电话跟诊所说我会「迟到」。

examples.en: The clinic asked me to explain the late arrival when I checked in at reception.
examples.zh: 我到前台报到时，诊所请我说明「迟到」的原因。

words.enDefinition: taking longer than the original timetable allowed

examples.en: The receptionist said the doctor was running behind schedule and offered to text me an update.
examples.zh: 前台说医生「看诊进度比预定晚」，可以发短信告诉我最新情况。

examples.en: I called my flatmate after reception explained that the clinic was running behind schedule.
examples.zh: 前台解释诊所「进度比预定晚」后，我给室友打了电话。

collocations: running behind schedule by twenty minutes

words.enDefinition: a list of people offered times that others cancel

examples.en: I asked to join the cancellation list because I could come in at short notice.
examples.zh: 我随时都能抽出时间，就请前台把我加进「退约候补名单」。

examples.en: The receptionist called someone from the cancellation list when the early appointment became free.
examples.zh: 早上的预约一空出来，前台就给「退约候补名单」上的人打了电话。

collocations: put someone on the cancellation list
call someone from the cancellation list

words.enDefinition: an approximation of how long someone must wait

examples.en: The screen showed an estimated wait time of thirty minutes after I checked in.
examples.zh: 我报到后，屏幕上显示的「预计等待时间」是三十分钟。

examples.en: I asked reception for the estimated wait time before deciding whether to call my tutor.
examples.zh: 我先问了前台「预计等待时间」，再决定要不要给导师打电话。

collocations: ask for the estimated wait time

words.enDefinition: a room where healthcare staff see or examine patients

examples.en: The receptionist told me to wait in the exam room until the clinician arrived.
examples.zh: 前台让我在「诊室」等医务人员过来。

examples.en: I left my umbrella in the exam room after my appointment on a rainy afternoon.
examples.zh: 一个下雨的下午，我看完诊把伞忘在了「诊室」。

words.enDefinition: to be asked to enter when one's turn comes

examples.en: I kept my headphones off so I would hear when it was time to get called in.
examples.zh: 我没戴耳机，免得「被叫进去」的时候听不见。

examples.en: We were told where to wait until it was time to get called in.
examples.zh: 工作人员告诉我们「被叫进去」看诊前在哪里等。

collocations: be next to get called in
get called in for an appointment

words.enDefinition: a number or code identifying a patient's record

examples.en: The receptionist asked for my patient ID after I said I had visited the clinic before.
examples.zh: 我说之前来过诊所，前台就问了我的「患者识别号」。

examples.en: I found the patient ID at the top of the letter from the medical practice.
examples.zh: 我在诊所寄来的信件顶端找到了「患者识别号」。

words.enDefinition: the way someone would most like to be contacted

examples.en: I selected text messages as my preferred contact method because I am usually in class.
examples.zh: 我经常在上课，就把短信选为「首选联系方式」。

examples.en: The receptionist confirmed my preferred contact method before sending a message about the appointment.
examples.zh: 前台先确认了我的「首选联系方式」，然后发来了有关预约的消息。

words.enDefinition: requirements for making a service usable and accessible

examples.en: The appointment form asked about accessibility needs so staff could prepare the room in advance.
examples.zh: 预约表询问了「无障碍需求」，以便工作人员提前准备好诊室。

examples.en: I told the clinic about my accessibility needs when I phoned to confirm the booking.
examples.zh: 我打电话确认预约时，告诉了诊所我的「无障碍需求」。

words.enDefinition: an interpreter who helps people communicate during healthcare visits

examples.en: I asked whether a medical interpreter could join my appointment at the local clinic.
examples.zh: 我问「医疗口译员」能不能参加我在当地诊所的就诊。

examples.en: The medical interpreter joined the call after the receptionist confirmed which language I preferred.
examples.zh: 前台确认了我希望使用的语言后，「医疗口译员」加入了通话。

words.enDefinition: an interpreter who translates spoken communication by telephone

examples.en: The clinic arranged a phone interpreter to help when the doctor asked about my medical history.
examples.zh: 医生要询问病史，诊所安排了「电话口译员」协助沟通。

examples.en: I asked whether a phone interpreter could help me understand the nurse during the appointment.
examples.zh: 我问看诊时能不能请「电话口译员」帮我听懂护士的话。

words.enDefinition: an impartial observer present during a medical examination

examples.en: The clinician explained the role of a medical chaperone before asking what I would prefer.
examples.zh: 医务人员先解释了「检查在场见证员」的职责，再问我希望怎么安排。

examples.en: I told the receptionist I would like a medical chaperone present during the examination.
examples.zh: 我告诉前台，希望检查时有「检查在场见证员」在场。

words.enDefinition: someone who accompanies a patient to provide personal support

examples.en: I brought a support person to help me remember the questions I wanted to ask.
examples.zh: 我带了一位「就诊陪同人员」，帮我记住想问的问题。

examples.en: The clinic asked whether my support person would join the appointment in the room.
examples.zh: 诊所问我的「就诊陪同人员」会不会一起进诊室。

words.enDefinition: arrangements that let people using wheelchairs enter and move around

examples.en: I asked about wheelchair access before booking a visit to the clinic's new building.
examples.zh: 预约去诊所的新楼前，我先问了「轮椅通行条件」。

examples.en: The receptionist sent a map showing which entrance provided wheelchair access from the street.
examples.zh: 前台发来地图，标明从街上进楼哪个入口有「轮椅通行条件」。

words.enDefinition: a consultation whose discussion is kept private

examples.en: The clinic offered a confidential consultation in a room away from the waiting area.
examples.zh: 诊所在远离候诊区的房间安排了「保密问诊」。

examples.en: I requested a confidential consultation because I wanted to discuss something sensitive without my roommate present.
examples.zh: 我想在室友不在场时聊一件敏感的事，就申请了「保密问诊」。

words.enDefinition: protection of personal information shared during healthcare

examples.en: The clinic explained patient confidentiality before asking me to share my history with the nurse.
examples.zh: 诊所先说明了「患者信息保密」的规定，再请我把病史告诉护士。

examples.en: I asked what patient confidentiality meant for messages sent through the clinic's online portal.
examples.zh: 我问，诊所网上平台发送消息时，「患者信息保密」具体意味着什么。

words.enDefinition: written details recorded by a clinician during a consultation

examples.en: The doctor reviewed the consultation notes before sending a message about our last appointment.
examples.zh: 医生先看了「问诊记录」，再发来有关我们上次就诊的消息。

examples.en: I asked whether the consultation notes would be available through the clinic's online portal.
examples.zh: 我问能不能在诊所的网上平台里看到「问诊记录」。

collocations: request a copy of the consultation notes

words.enDefinition: a short written statement from a doctor about someone's health

examples.en: I asked whether the university would accept a doctor's note for the class I missed.
examples.zh: 我问学校缺课时能不能用「医生证明」来说明情况。

examples.en: The clinic told me where to collect my doctor's note after the appointment that morning.
examples.zh: 诊所告诉我，那天上午就诊后到哪里领取「医生证明」。

words.enDefinition: a UK document recording medical advice about ability to work

examples.en: My employer asked whether I could provide a fit note after more than a week off sick.
examples.zh: 我因病请假超过一周后，雇主问我能否提供「工作能力医疗证明」。

examples.en: I asked the receptionist where I could find the fit note in my account.
examples.zh: 我问前台在我的账户里哪里能找到「工作能力医疗证明」。

words.enDefinition: a patient-facing summary of a completed healthcare visit

examples.en: I read the after-visit summary because it listed who to contact about the next appointment.
examples.zh: 我读了「就诊后摘要」，因为上面写了下一次预约该联系谁。

examples.en: The nurse said the after-visit summary would appear in the portal later that day.
examples.zh: 护士说「就诊后摘要」当天晚些时候会出现在平台上。

words.enDefinition: a request to obtain or send copies of healthcare records

examples.en: I filed a medical records request when I transferred from one university to another.
examples.zh: 从一所大学转到另一所时，我提交了「医疗记录申请」。

examples.en: The office emailed to confirm that my medical records request had reached the correct department.
examples.zh: 办公室发邮件确认，我的「医疗记录申请」已转到正确的部门。

words.enDefinition: the authorized sharing of protected information with another party

examples.en: The form explained what the release of information would allow the new clinic to receive.
examples.zh: 表格说明了「授权提供医疗资料」后，新诊所可以收到哪些信息。

examples.en: The practice asked for permission before the release of information to my university adviser.
examples.zh: 诊所在「向学校顾问提供医疗资料」之前，先征求了我的授权。

collocations: consent to the release of information

words.enDefinition: a statement explaining how an organization handles personal information

examples.en: I read the privacy notice before entering my contact details on the clinic's website.
examples.zh: 我在诊所网站填写联系方式之前，先看了「隐私告知书」。

examples.en: The receptionist pointed out where I could find the privacy notice in the registration pack.
examples.zh: 前台指给我看，登记资料中的「隐私告知书」在哪里。

words.enDefinition: a short handout explaining what patients need to know

examples.en: The clinic gave me a patient information leaflet with a map and the reception number.
examples.zh: 诊所给了我一份「患者须知折页」，上面有地图和前台电话。

examples.en: I found the answers to several booking questions in the patient information leaflet they sent.
examples.zh: 他们发来的「患者须知折页」里解答了我好几个预约问题。

collocations: a copy of the patient information leaflet

words.enDefinition: a digital record of someone's healthcare information

examples.en: The clinician opened my electronic health record to check which clinic had seen me before.
examples.zh: 医务人员打开我的「电子健康档案」，查看我之前去过哪家诊所。

examples.en: I asked whether a change of address would show up in my electronic health record.
examples.zh: 我问地址更改后，我的「电子健康档案」里会不会显示。

words.enDefinition: to send a patient's health records to another provider

examples.en: I asked the old practice whether it could transfer medical records before my first visit.
examples.zh: 我首次就诊前，问原来的诊所能不能「转交医疗记录」。

examples.en: The new clinic explained how to transfer medical records after I changed universities last term.
examples.zh: 我上学期转学以后，新诊所说明了如何「转交医疗记录」。

words.enDefinition: a document recording someone's permission for a particular action

examples.en: I read the consent form and asked about a line that I did not understand.
examples.zh: 我看了「同意书」，还问了一句自己没弄懂的话。

examples.en: The receptionist offered me a translated consent form after I asked for help reading it.
examples.zh: 我说需要人帮忙看，前台就给了我一份翻译过的「同意书」。

words.enDefinition: to take back permission that was previously given

examples.en: I asked how to withdraw consent for a copy of the records to be shared.
examples.zh: 我问怎样「撤回同意」，不再允许转交那份记录副本。

examples.en: The administrator explained whom to contact if I later chose to withdraw consent for that release.
examples.zh: 管理员说明，如果我后来决定「撤回同意」不再提供那些信息，该联系谁。

words.enDefinition: a set of written questions for a patient to answer

examples.en: The patient questionnaire asked which language I preferred to use during an appointment at the clinic.
examples.zh: 「患者问卷」问我在诊所看病时希望用哪种语言。

examples.en: I completed the patient questionnaire on my phone while waiting for the morning bus.
examples.zh: 等早班公交时，我在手机上填了「患者问卷」。

words.enDefinition: information about a person's past and present health

examples.en: The nurse reviewed my medical history before asking about the dates of my earlier appointments.
examples.zh: 护士先看了我的「病史」，再问我之前几次就诊的日期。

examples.en: I brought a short summary of my medical history from the clinic near my old university.
examples.zh: 我带来了一份原学校附近诊所出具的简短「病史」摘要。

words.enDefinition: health information about conditions that affected biological relatives

examples.en: The questionnaire asked about family medical history, so I checked with my parents that evening.
examples.zh: 问卷问了「家族病史」，我当晚就向父母核实了情况。

examples.en: I said I knew very little about my family medical history when the nurse asked.
examples.zh: 护士问起时，我说自己对「家族病史」了解不多。

words.enDefinition: a record of operations a person has had before

examples.en: The nurse asked about my surgical history while updating my record for the new practice.
examples.zh: 护士在给新诊所更新档案时，问了我的「手术史」。

examples.en: I left the surgical history section blank because I wanted to check the dates first.
examples.zh: 我想先核对日期，就把「手术史」这一栏留空了。

words.enDefinition: the date when a condition was identified by a clinician

examples.en: The form asked for the date of diagnosis, but I only remembered the year.
examples.zh: 表格要求填写「确诊日期」，但我只记得是哪一年。

examples.en: I checked the old letter for the date of diagnosis before contacting the new clinic.
examples.zh: 联系新诊所前，我在旧信里查了「确诊日期」。

collocations: ask for the date of diagnosis

words.enDefinition: a health condition already present before a specified point

examples.en: The nurse asked whether a pre-existing condition had been recorded before my first appointment.
examples.zh: 护士问，我首次就诊前有没有登记过某项「既有健康问题」。

examples.en: I asked whether the questionnaire wanted details of any pre-existing condition or only current symptoms.
examples.zh: 我问问卷要填的是所有「既有健康问题」，还是只填目前的症状。

words.enDefinition: the identification of a condition recorded as present now

examples.en: I asked the clinician whether the current diagnosis was listed in the summary available online.
examples.zh: 我问医务人员，网上的摘要里有没有列出「当前诊断」。

examples.en: The nurse checked the current diagnosis against the information the previous clinic had sent.
examples.zh: 护士把「当前诊断」和上一家诊所发来的资料做了核对。

words.enDefinition: a health condition that persists over a long period

examples.en: The form asked whether I received regular care for a chronic condition in my home country.
examples.zh: 表格问我之前在自己的国家有没有为「慢性疾病」定期就诊。

examples.en: I brought a letter about my chronic condition when I met the new doctor.
examples.zh: 见新医生时，我带了一封关于自己「慢性疾病」的信。

words.enDefinition: care or treatment a person received before the current visit

examples.en: The doctor asked about past treatment and read the information my old practice had sent.
examples.zh: 医生问了「既往治疗」情况，还看了原来诊所发来的资料。

examples.en: I brought a summary of my past treatment because I did not remember every detail.
examples.zh: 有些细节我记不清，就带了一份「既往治疗」的摘要。

words.enDefinition: the main problem that brought someone for medical care

examples.en: The clinician wrote down my presenting complaint before asking for more details about my history.
examples.zh: 医务人员记下我的「主诉」，然后询问更详细的病史。

examples.en: The assessment form has a space for presenting complaint just below the patient's details.
examples.zh: 评估表在患者资料下方留了一栏填「主诉」。

words.enDefinition: an account of when symptoms began and changed

examples.en: I made a symptom timeline so I could explain what had changed since last term.
examples.zh: 我整理了「症状时间线」，好说明自上学期以来有哪些变化。

examples.en: The clinician looked at my symptom timeline while checking the dates in the old notes.
examples.zh: 医务人员核对旧病历上的日期时，看了我的「症状时间线」。

collocations: bring a symptom timeline to an appointment

words.enDefinition: to explain what changes or problems you are experiencing

examples.en: The first question on the form says to describe your symptoms in your own words.
examples.zh: 表单的第一个问题让你用自己的话「描述你的症状」。

examples.en: The interpreter can help you describe your symptoms during the appointment if needed.
examples.zh: 如果需要，口译员可以在问诊时帮你「描述你的症状」。

collocations: describe your symptoms in your own words
describe your symptoms to the clinician

words.enDefinition: measurements of basic body functions such as pulse and temperature

examples.en: The nurse recorded my vital signs before I went into the room for the consultation.
examples.zh: 护士先记录了我的「生命体征」，我才进诊室问诊。

examples.en: I asked the nurse where the vital signs would appear in my visit summary.
examples.zh: 我问护士，「生命体征」会显示在就诊摘要的什么位置。

words.enDefinition: the measured values for a person's blood pressure

examples.en: The nurse entered my blood pressure reading in the computer after checking my name.
examples.zh: 护士核对我的姓名后，把「血压读数」录入了电脑。

examples.en: I asked whether the blood pressure reading would be included in the printed summary.
examples.zh: 我问打印的摘要里会不会包括「血压读数」。

words.enDefinition: to check the health information you have supplied

examples.en: The doctor said, “I will review your medical history before we discuss the referral.”
examples.zh: 医生说：“讨论转诊前，我会先「查看你的病史」。”

examples.en: The appointment page says the clinician will review your medical history at the first visit.
examples.zh: 预约页面写着，医务人员在你第一次看诊时会「查看你的病史」。

collocations: review your medical history before the visit
ask a clinician to review your medical history

words.enDefinition: a record of medicines a person currently takes

examples.en: I printed my medication list so I could hand it to the clinician at reception.
examples.zh: 我打印了「用药清单」，方便在前台交给医务人员。

examples.en: The nurse compared my medication list with the information in the previous clinic's records.
examples.zh: 护士把我的「用药清单」和上一家诊所记录里的信息核对了一下。

words.enDefinition: an allergic sensitivity that a person already knows about

examples.en: The nurse asked me to report any known allergy before she finalized the intake form.
examples.zh: 护士让我说明是否有「已知过敏情况」，再完成接诊资料表。

examples.en: I checked the portal to make sure my known allergy was still on the list.
examples.zh: 我看了一眼平台，确认「已知过敏情况」仍在清单上。

words.enDefinition: a statement that no allergies have been identified so far

examples.en: I saw no known allergies in my record and asked the nurse what it meant.
examples.zh: 我在档案里看到「无已知过敏」，就问护士这是什么意思。

examples.en: The form offered “no known allergies” as an option next to the allergy question.
examples.zh: 表格在询问过敏情况的题目旁提供了「无已知过敏」选项。

words.enDefinition: a clinician's evaluation of a person's condition and needs

examples.en: The specialist explained what the clinical assessment would cover before discussing my previous records.
examples.zh: 专科医生先解释了「临床评估」会涉及什么，再谈我之前的记录。

examples.en: I received a short message about where to go for the clinical assessment next week.
examples.zh: 我收到一条短消息，告诉我下周去哪里做「临床评估」。

collocations: the results of a clinical assessment

words.enDefinition: a healthcare professional who works directly with patients

examples.en: The receptionist asked which clinician I wanted to see before checking the available times.
examples.zh: 前台先问我想看哪位「临床医务人员」，再查可约时间。

examples.en: I gave the clinician the letter that the previous practice had sent to me.
examples.zh: 我把原来诊所寄给我的信交给了「临床医务人员」。

words.enDefinition: a nurse who works in a general medical practice

examples.en: The practice nurse called my name while I was checking a message from class.
examples.zh: 我正看班上的消息时，「全科诊所护士」叫到了我的名字。

examples.en: The receptionist told me which appointments were available with the practice nurse that week.
examples.zh: 前台告诉我，那周「全科诊所护士」有哪些可预约的时间。

collocations: an appointment with the practice nurse

words.enDefinition: a nurse with advanced training who provides clinical care

examples.en: The receptionist offered me an appointment with a nurse practitioner at the campus clinic.
examples.zh: 前台帮我约了校园诊所的一位「高级执业护士」。

examples.en: I met the nurse practitioner who had reviewed the notes from my previous visit.
examples.zh: 我见到了之前看过我上次就诊记录的那位「高级执业护士」。

words.enDefinition: a trained clinician who provides care within a medical team

examples.en: The physician assistant introduced herself before asking which clinic had sent the referral.
examples.zh: 「医师助理」先做了自我介绍，再问是哪家诊所发来的转诊。

examples.en: I asked the receptionist whether my appointment was with the physician assistant that day.
examples.zh: 我问前台，那天我约的是不是「医师助理」。

collocations: an appointment with a physician assistant

words.enDefinition: a worker supporting a clinic with basic tasks and administration

examples.en: The medical assistant showed me to the room where the doctor would see me.
examples.zh: 「医疗助理」带我去了医生给我看诊的房间。

examples.en: I gave the medical assistant the completed form before returning to the waiting room.
examples.zh: 我把填好的表格交给「医疗助理」，然后回了候诊室。

words.zhGloss: 登记成为全科医生的患者
words.enDefinition: to join a general practitioner's practice as a patient
acceptedZhAnswers: 登记成为全科医生的患者

examples.en: I wanted to register with a GP close to the flat I had just rented.
examples.zh: 我刚租了公寓，想在附近「登记成为一位全科医生的患者」。

examples.en: The university adviser showed me where to register with a GP after I arrived.
examples.zh: 我到了以后，学校顾问给我指了可以「登记成为全科医生的患者」的地方。

collocations: help someone register with a GP

words.enDefinition: taking on people who have not used a practice before

examples.en: I asked if the practice was accepting new patients after moving away from campus.
examples.zh: 搬离校园后，我问那家诊所是否「正在接收新患者」。

examples.en: The clinic explained why it was not accepting new patients at its smaller branch.
examples.zh: 诊所解释了为什么较小的分诊点没有「接收新患者」。

collocations: check which providers are accepting new patients

words.enDefinition: the geographic area a particular service normally covers

examples.en: I checked the catchment area before choosing a practice near my new student flat.
examples.zh: 我先查了「服务覆盖区」，再选自己新租的学生公寓附近的诊所。

examples.en: The receptionist asked for my postcode to check whether I lived in the catchment area.
examples.zh: 前台问我的邮编，核对我是否住在「服务覆盖区」内。

words.enDefinition: coordinated care that remains consistent over time and across visits

examples.en: I asked about continuity of care because I was changing practices at the end of term.
examples.zh: 学期结束时我要换诊所，就问了怎么保证「医疗照护连续性」。

examples.en: The clinic mentioned continuity of care when it explained how teams share patient records.
examples.zh: 诊所说明各团队怎么共享病历时，提到了「医疗照护连续性」。

words.enDefinition: a UK general practitioner assigned to oversee a patient's care

examples.en: I used the patient portal to find out who my named GP was.
examples.zh: 我通过患者门户查到了「指定的全科医生」是谁。

examples.en: The letter showed my named GP along with the number for the practice reception.
examples.zh: 信上列出了我的「指定的全科医生」和诊所前台的电话。

words.enDefinition: to attend a consultation with an expert in a medical field

examples.en: I asked the receptionist where I would need to go to see a specialist.
examples.zh: 我问前台要去哪里才能「看专科医生」。

examples.en: My tutor asked when I would see a specialist so we could move our meeting.
examples.zh: 导师问我什么时候要「看专科医生」，好重新安排见面时间。

words.enDefinition: a request for a patient to receive specialist care

examples.en: The clinic said it had sent my specialist referral to the hospital near campus.
examples.zh: 诊所说已经把我的「专科转诊」提交给校区附近的医院。

examples.en: I checked the address on the specialist referral before phoning the hospital's booking team.
examples.zh: 我先核对了「专科转诊」上的地址，再打电话给医院的预约部门。

collocations: follow up on a specialist referral

words.enDefinition: a document giving information needed for a referral

examples.en: I noticed the wrong phone number on the referral form before the clinic sent it.
examples.zh: 诊所发出之前，我发现「转诊表」上的电话号码错了。

examples.en: The hospital asked the practice to attach the earlier notes to the referral form.
examples.zh: 医院请诊所把之前的记录附在「转诊表」后面。

words.enDefinition: the steps and services involved in arranging onward care

examples.en: The adviser explained the referral pathway and showed me who handled each stage.
examples.zh: 顾问解释了「转诊流程」，还指明了每一阶段由谁办理。

examples.en: The clinic's website outlined the referral pathway before listing the relevant contact numbers.
examples.zh: 诊所网站先概述了「转诊流程」，再列出相关联系电话。

words.enDefinition: requesting access to a service without another clinician's referral

examples.en: I asked about self-referral because the service's website offered an online form for students.
examples.zh: 该服务网站上有供学生用的在线表格，我就问了「自行申请就诊」。

examples.en: The receptionist explained which services accepted self-referral when I called to ask about booking.
examples.zh: 我打电话询问预约时，前台解释了哪些服务受理「自行申请就诊」。

words.enDefinition: a referral made through the ordinary scheduling process

examples.en: The practice sent a routine referral and told me which department would contact me.
examples.zh: 诊所提交了「常规转诊」，并告诉我哪个科室会联系我。

examples.en: I asked about the status of my routine referral before leaving town for the holidays.
examples.zh: 放假离开这座城市之前，我问了「常规转诊」的进度。

words.enDefinition: a referral sent for review sooner than usual

examples.en: The doctor mentioned an urgent referral and explained who would call me about the booking.
examples.zh: 医生提到了「加急转诊」，并说明谁会打电话告诉我预约安排。

examples.en: The office asked me to verify my phone number after logging the urgent referral.
examples.zh: 办公室登记了「加急转诊」后，请我核实电话号码。

words.enDefinition: a referral to another service within the same organization

examples.en: The clinician submitted an internal referral to another department in the same outpatient building.
examples.zh: 医务人员给同一栋门诊楼里的另一个科室提交了「机构内部转诊」。

examples.en: I asked whether the internal referral would appear in the same patient portal account.
examples.zh: 我问在同一个患者平台账户里能不能看到「机构内部转诊」。

collocations: follow up on an internal referral

words.enDefinition: the healthcare professional who sends someone for further care

examples.en: The hospital asked for the name of the referring clinician before looking up my appointment.
examples.zh: 医院先问「转诊医务人员」的姓名，再查我的预约。

examples.en: I let the referring clinician know that the specialist had received my earlier notes.
examples.zh: 我告诉「转诊医务人员」，专科医生已经收到我之前的记录了。

words.enDefinition: a worker who helps arrange and track referrals

examples.en: The referral coordinator called to check whether I could attend the appointment after my lab.
examples.zh: 「转诊协调员」打电话问我上完实验课后能不能来赴约。

examples.en: I sent the referral coordinator a message when the specialist changed the clinic address.
examples.zh: 专科医生换了诊所地址后，我给「转诊协调员」发了消息。

words.enDefinition: the current stage of a request for onward care

examples.en: I checked the referral status before calling the hospital booking line again this morning.
examples.zh: 今天上午我先看了「转诊进度」，才再给医院预约专线打电话。

examples.en: The receptionist explained why my referral status had not changed in the online system.
examples.zh: 前台解释了为什么网上系统里的「转诊进度」一直没变。

words.enDefinition: assessing a request by phone to determine its priority

examples.en: The clinic uses telephone triage before deciding which team should handle an appointment request.
examples.zh: 诊所用「电话分诊」先了解情况，再决定由哪个团队办理预约。

examples.en: I confirmed my callback number before the receptionist passed my details to telephone triage.
examples.zh: 前台把我的资料交给「电话分诊」之前，我确认了回拨号码。

words.enDefinition: the level of urgency assigned to an appointment request

examples.en: A nurse checked the appointment priority after the receptionist took notes during our call.
examples.zh: 前台在通话中做了记录后，护士核对了「预约优先级」。

examples.en: I asked how appointment priority was shown on the form before submitting my request.
examples.zh: 提交申请前，我问表格上是怎么显示「预约优先级」的。

words.enDefinition: to ask for more time with a healthcare professional

examples.en: I called the clinic to request a longer appointment because I wanted time to ask questions.
examples.zh: 我想留出时间提问，就打电话给诊所「申请延长就诊时间」。

examples.en: The booking page explains how to request a longer appointment if you need an interpreter.
examples.zh: 预约页面说明，如果需要口译员，如何「申请延长就诊时间」。

collocations: call to request a longer appointment
email to request a longer appointment
request a longer appointment when booking

words.enDefinition: a booking that uses two ordinary appointment slots together

examples.en: The receptionist booked a double appointment so there would be extra time for the interpreter.
examples.zh: 前台安排了「双时段预约」，给口译多留一些时间。

examples.en: I asked whether a double appointment would be available on my day off next week.
examples.zh: 我问下周我休息的那天能不能约到「双时段预约」。

words.enDefinition: a doctor filling in temporarily for another doctor

examples.en: The receptionist told me a locum doctor was covering while my usual doctor was away.
examples.zh: 前台告诉我，常看的医生不在，有一位「临时代诊医生」替班。

examples.en: I showed the locum doctor the letter I had received from my regular clinic.
examples.zh: 我把常去的诊所寄来的信给「临时代诊医生」看了。

collocations: arrange cover with a locum doctor
an appointment with a locum doctor

words.enDefinition: the group of people supporting someone's healthcare

examples.en: I asked who on the care team could answer a question about my appointment.
examples.zh: 我问「医疗照护团队」里有谁能回答我的预约问题。

examples.en: The message told me how to contact the care team if my schedule changed.
examples.zh: 消息里写明，如果我的日程变了，如何联系「医疗照护团队」。

collocations: a member of the care team

words.enDefinition: a person who helps organize a patient's services

examples.en: The care coordinator helped me work out which clinic would handle the next appointment.
examples.zh: 「照护协调员」帮我弄清了下次就诊归哪家诊所安排。

examples.en: I emailed the care coordinator because two departments had sent me conflicting appointment dates.
examples.zh: 两个科室发来的预约日期有冲突，我就发邮件给「照护协调员」。

words.enDefinition: to move one's ongoing care to a different practice

examples.en: I decided to switch to another practice that was closer to my new accommodation.
examples.zh: 我决定「换到另一家诊所」，离我的新住处更近。

examples.en: The student adviser said I could ask how to switch to another practice after moving.
examples.zh: 学生顾问说，我搬家后可以问怎样「换到另一家诊所」。

collocations: plan to switch to another practice
ask how to switch to another practice
decide to switch to another practice

words.enDefinition: a later phone call to check on a previous matter

examples.en: The nurse arranged a follow-up call so I could ask about the written summary.
examples.zh: 护士安排了「后续电话联系」，方便我询问书面摘要。

examples.en: I left my morning class earlier than usual because I was expecting a follow-up call.
examples.zh: 我在等「后续电话联系」，就比平时早一点离开了上午的课堂。

words.enDefinition: an outline of what will happen after a consultation

examples.en: I asked for the follow-up plan before leaving because I wanted to note the dates.
examples.zh: 离开之前，我要了「后续安排」，想把几个日期记下来。

examples.en: The after-visit summary described a follow-up plan and gave the number for the booking office.
examples.zh: 就诊后摘要说明了「后续安排」，还给了预约办公室的电话。

words.enDefinition: directions explaining what to do after a visit

examples.en: The receptionist printed the follow-up instructions because the portal was temporarily unavailable that morning.
examples.zh: 那天上午平台暂时打不开，前台打印了「后续事项说明」。

examples.en: I read the follow-up instructions to find the department I should contact about the appointment.
examples.zh: 我看了「后续事项说明」，找到了预约应该联系的科室。

words.enDefinition: a consultation arranged to discuss the outcome of tests

examples.en: The clinic texted me about a results appointment when my test results came back.
examples.zh: 检查结果出来后，诊所发短信通知我「检查结果解读预约」的安排。

examples.en: I asked whether the results appointment would take place by phone or in the clinic.
examples.zh: 我问「检查结果解读预约」是电话沟通，还是到诊所现场。

words.enDefinition: the findings produced by a medical examination or test

examples.en: The receptionist explained which tab showed my test results on the clinic website.
examples.zh: 前台说明了在诊所网站的哪个标签页可以看到「检查结果」。

examples.en: I asked whether the specialist had received the test results from my previous clinic.
examples.zh: 我问专科医生有没有收到上一家诊所发来的「检查结果」。

words.enDefinition: test findings that are not yet available

examples.en: The summary listed pending results and explained where new information would appear online.
examples.zh: 摘要列出了「尚未出具的结果」，并说明新信息会在网上哪里显示。

examples.en: I asked which team I should contact about pending results after changing clinics this semester.
examples.zh: 这学期换了诊所，我问该联系哪个团队查询「尚未出具的结果」。

words.enDefinition: to look through and discuss the findings with you

examples.en: The doctor said, “I’ll review your results with you before we finish the appointment.”
examples.zh: 医生说：“就诊结束前，我会和你一起「查看你的检查结果」。”

examples.en: The reminder says the clinician can review your results during the visit next week.
examples.zh: 提醒消息说，医务人员可以在下周就诊时「查看你的检查结果」。

collocations: review your results at the clinic
wait for a clinician to review your results

words.enDefinition: to ask someone to phone you at a later time

examples.en: I used the form to request a callback after my tutorial finished on Monday.
examples.zh: 星期一辅导课结束后，我用表单「请求回电」。

examples.en: The receptionist said I could request a callback if I could not stay on hold.
examples.zh: 前台说如果我不能一直在线等待，可以「请求回电」。

collocations: use the portal to request a callback
request a callback from the clinic

words.enDefinition: the telephone number someone should use to call back

examples.en: The receptionist repeated my callback number to make sure I had given it correctly.
examples.zh: 前台把我的「回拨号码」重复了一遍，确认我报对了。

examples.en: I left a different callback number because my old phone was being repaired that week.
examples.zh: 那周旧手机正在维修，我就留了另一个「回拨号码」。

words.enDefinition: to record a spoken message for someone to hear later

examples.en: I decided to leave a voicemail after hearing that the reception desk was closed.
examples.zh: 听到语音提示说前台下班了，我决定「留一条语音留言」。

examples.en: The booking office asked me to leave a voicemail with my name and phone number.
examples.zh: 预约办公室让我「留一条语音留言」，说清姓名和电话号码。

collocations: leave a voicemail after the tone
leave a voicemail with your number
ask someone to leave a voicemail

words.enDefinition: a scheduled visit to a medical laboratory

examples.en: I moved my lab appointment to the morning before my first lecture of the week.
examples.zh: 我把「检验预约」改到了这周第一节课前的上午。

examples.en: The clinic sent a message confirming the address for my lab appointment next Tuesday.
examples.zh: 诊所发消息确认了下周二「检验预约」的地址。

words.enDefinition: an examination of the body by a healthcare professional

examples.en: The clinician explained what the physical exam would involve before asking for my agreement.
examples.zh: 医务人员先说明「身体检查」会做什么，再征求我的同意。

examples.en: The form said to ask the clinician any questions before the physical exam began.
examples.zh: 表格写明，「身体检查」开始前有问题可以问医务人员。

words.enDefinition: to make the expected following actions clear

examples.en: I asked the receptionist to clarify the next steps after the specialist changed my appointment.
examples.zh: 专科医生改了预约后，我请前台帮我「弄清下一步安排」。

examples.en: We met briefly after the consultation to clarify the next steps for booking a return visit.
examples.zh: 问诊后我们简单碰了个面，以便「弄清下一步安排」，预约再次就诊。

collocations: ask someone to clarify the next steps
clarify the next steps in writing
meet to clarify the next steps

words.enDefinition: an assessment by another professional after an initial opinion

examples.en: I asked whom I could contact for a second opinion about the specialist's assessment.
examples.zh: 我问该联系谁，就这位专科医生的评估征求「第二诊疗意见」。

examples.en: My adviser explained where to look for a second opinion and which documents to bring.
examples.zh: 顾问告诉我去哪里征求「第二诊疗意见」、需要带哪些资料。

words.enDefinition: initial questions used to decide what further review is needed

examples.en: The online form began with screening questions before asking which appointment time worked for me.
examples.zh: 在线表单先列出「筛查问题」，然后才问我哪个预约时间合适。

examples.en: I asked the nurse why the clinic repeated the screening questions at my second visit.
examples.zh: 我问护士，为什么第二次去诊所时又问了「筛查问题」。

words.enDefinition: an identification card used to access healthcare in some systems

examples.en: The clinic asked me to show my health card when I arrived for the appointment.
examples.zh: 我到诊所赴约时，前台请我出示「医疗服务卡」。

examples.en: I asked which details from my health card I needed to enter on the form.
examples.zh: 我问表格里需要填写「医疗服务卡」上的哪些信息。
